note: MATLAB R2025a spectrumAnalyzer captures (scope_capture.m, run 1 = run.log, run 2 = run2.log resume with a NEW scope object) of the SPECTRAL MASK test: every field of getSpectralMaskStatus after each sa() call, plus the SimulationTime of the getSpectrumData row of that call (spectrum_simulation_time). Only the configuration, the status numbers, the signal reference and the 10 distinct displayed spectra are kept here; rules in b34/scope_capture/ANALYSIS_mask.md / rules_mask.json (analyze_mask.py).

A.layout: 4000 rows per call, columns ch1 ch2 (%.17g)

B.layout: 4000 rows per call, columns re im (%.17g)

spectrum_model.nfft: max(1024, WindowLength) (FFTLengthSource auto; observed for 1000 -> 1024 and 4000 -> 4000)
spectrum_model.scaling: 'power': |fft(w.*x)|^2 / sum(w)^2, one-sided interior bins x2; dBm = 10*log10(P) + 30 (ReferenceLoad 1)
spectrum_model.grid: one-sided k*fs/nfft, k = 0..nfft/2; two-sided k = -(nfft/2-1)..nfft/2 (Nyquist at the end); plus scope FrequencyOffset
spectrum_model.averaging: AveragingMethod 'running', SpectralAverages N: normalised exponential average of all segment periodograms since release(), lambda = (N-1)/(N+1); one displayed spectrum (= one test) per sa() call
spectrum_model.simulation_time: status SimulationTime = time of the last processed sample, accumulated per call since release: t_k = t_{k-1} + n_k/fs with t_0 = -1/fs (3.999, 7.9990000000000006, 11.999, 15.999)
